notes.title: 🎓 Sex Dorm 🔞 — College Life Like You’ve Never Seen Before! 🎓
notes.content:
You’ve moved to the U.S. to experience university life, but the journey isn’t just about books and classes.In Sex Dorm, explore new cultures, meet exciting people, and dive into your hidden desires as you navigate the thrill of college life.Will you balance studies, part-time work, and relationships — or will you embrace the temptation that college life offers?Play now on Steam and start your college adventure!

 What awaits you in the dorms?📍 Build relationships with captivating characters📍 Work part-time and earn your way through school📍 Discover new cultures and push boundaries📍 Adult content that evolves with your choices
